(35 I 5) J 9 K 23 L 39 K (3 J 8) = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: (35 I 5) J 9 K 23 L 39 K (3 J 8) = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 I
 J
 K
 L
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 -
 +
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ (__**35 ÷ 5**__) × 9 - 23 + 39 - (__**3 × 8**__) = ?

⇒ __**7**____** × 9**__ - 23 + 39 - 24 = ?

⇒ __**63**__ - 23 __**+ 39**__ - 24 = ?

⇒ __102 - 23 - 24__ 

⇒ __**102 - 47**__ = 55.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some shells are pebbles.

All pebbles are rocks.

**Conclusions:**

I. No shell is a rock.

II. Some shells are rocks.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some shells are pebbles.

All pebbles are rocks.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c497d715e680e44b932adcf30e9cda7b9a21ad0b8509ccb6746be363ed4f63f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No shell is a rock - False (Because, Some shells are rocks).

II. Some shells are rocks - True (Because, Those parts of shells which is pebbles will also rocks).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All valleys are mountains.

No sea is a mountain.

Some plains are seas.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some valleys are plains.

II. No plain is a mountain.

III. No sea is a valley.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All valleys are mountains.

No sea is a mountain.

Some plains are seas.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9536311d6baf412fb7687fc3d9622a2b2ace47f4998a7739d7774d7eaa1a6f84.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some valleys are plains - False (Because, No definite relation given between valleys and plains, So, Some valleys are plains can be possible only).

II. No plain is a mountain - False (Because, No definite relation given between plain and mountain, So, No plain is a mountain can be possible only).

III. No sea is a valley - True (Because, All the valleys are mountains and No mountain is Sea, so No sea is a valley).

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
